method: Read-only fetches with user agent lexflow-research/0.1 (https://github.com/alibama/lexflow), robots.txt obeyed, at least 1.5 seconds between requests per host, no browser, no forms, no logins. HTML text extracted with scripts and styles dropped; PDFs with pdftotext (layout and raw passes). Docker was down, so every quote is marked source: official-page and was checked locally as a normalised substring of the fetched text (309 of 309 matched; 14 of them only in the raw-order PDF text, which lexflow's matcher also uses). Municode (library.municode.com) was not read because its terms forbid reprinting; cvillepedia and other unofficial sites were not used.

gaps: The City publishes no guide, checklist or page for opening a studio, makerspace, artisan workshop or manufacturing business; the sequence in glass_studio_overview is assembled from the Development Code, NDS, Fire, Utilities and Commissioner pages.

No written zoning determination on hot-glass, kiln or furnace studios is posted; whether a gas-fired hot shop is an 'Artisan workshop' (by right) or 'industrial and manufacturing' (size-limited or SUP) is not stated anywhere.

The Fire Marshal's Office publishes no list of the SFPC Table 107.2 operational permits it requires, no application forms and no fee schedule; City Code chapter 12 (fire prevention) is only partly reproduced on the Third Party Inspections page.

The NDS Fee Schedule is a scanned PDF; the building base rate (BR) and several rows (stop-work order, CO not required by USBC, Board of Appeals application, zoning compliance letters) are not legible or do not align in text extraction. The Permit Fee Calculations page returned no text.
Building Inspections publishes nothing on furnaces, glory holes, kilns or hot-shop ventilation, and does not explain the ICC Plan Review Services flyer.

Charlottesville Gas pages are residential: no commercial connection fee, no detail on elevated-pressure (PSIG) service, and no guidance on which rate schedule a continuously running furnace falls under.
No City page on industrial pretreatment, sewer-use limits or disposal of glass grinding slurry; City Code chapters 10 and 31 not read (Municode).

The Commissioner of the Revenue publishes no BPOL rate table for retail, service or manufacturing classifications, and no statement on whether a glass studio is a manufacturer for the wholesale exemption or the machinery and tools class.
The Blue Ridge Health District's fees conflict across pages ($80 application vs $40 plan review plus $40 permit).
Virginia ABC's retail licence page loaded as a navigation shell (no licence list); ABC licensing is pointed to, not modeled.
DEQ's air permit pages answered HTTP 403 to the research user agent; only the exemption regulation (9VAC5-80-1105) was read.

The City site's search endpoint is disallowed by robots.txt, so pages were found by following navigation links; a City page on fire permits, change-of-use procedure or occupancy permits could exist unlinked from the pages read.
